control.title: Timely Removal of Terminated User Access

risk: A former employee or contractor keeps access and records or changes financial data after leaving.
activity: HR records each termination in Workday. The system administrator receives the termination list in real time and disables or removes the leaver's accounts in Workday within 1 business day of the termination date.
understanding:
Control ITGC-AC-02 is a manual, event-driven control over Workday. HR records each termination in Workday. The system administrator receives the termination list and disables or removes the leaver's Workday accounts within 1 business day of the termination date [^1].

We walked through one instance with M. Santos, HRIS Security Administrator: the termination of Jordan Reyes (104582), Senior Payroll Analyst [^2].
procedures: Walked one instance through the control, from the HR termination to the removal of access, inspecting each system's own record.
Compared the termination date with the dates access was removed. The comparison was made in code from the dates the records state.
Inspected the parameters of the sign-on report, as information produced by the entity.

steps.step: HR starts the termination of Jordan Reyes (resignation); the HR Partner approves it.
steps.evidence: Business process history: Terminate Employee, initiated and approved. [^1]

steps.step: HR Operations approves. Workday notifies HRIS Security and opens ServiceNow RITM0048213 by itself, due 1 business day after the effective date.
steps.evidence: Notification email to HRIS Security Admins; ServiceNow ticket RITM0048213.
steps.result: Notification sent before the effective date.

steps.step: The termination takes effect and the Workday account is disabled the same day.
steps.evidence: Workday account screen: Account Disabled Yes, 09/30/2026 11:59:00 PM PT.

steps.step: Okta deactivates the user and removes single sign-on to Workday.
The security administrator removes the last user-based security group (Payroll Administrator); none remain.
steps.evidence: Security groups for the user, with the audit trail.

steps.step: The ticket is closed with the work notes, before it fell due at 11:59 PM.
steps.evidence: ServiceNow RITM0048213 work notes and closure.

steps.step: No sign-ons or attempted sign-ons on the account after removal.
steps.evidence: Workday Account Signons report for jreyes.

attributes.text: The leaver's access was disabled or removed, as shown by the system's own record of the change
attributes.basis: The Workday account reads Disabled; the audit trail shows the security group removed by M. Santos; Okta logs the deactivation.

attributes.text: Every account of the leaver was disabled or removed, not only the primary one
attributes.basis: Three places were checked: the Workday account, its security groups (none remain), and single sign-on through Okta.

attributes.text: Access was removed within 1 business day of the HR termination date
attributes.basis: Effective 09/30/2026. Disabled 09/30 11:59 PM; single sign-on off 10/01 12:05 AM; group removed 10/01 10:18 AM. All before the limit of 10/01 11:59 PM.
checks: Checked in code: termination 30 September 2026, disabled 30 September 2026: the same day.

attributes.text: Where access was removed late, activity on the account after the termination date was checked
attributes.basis: Not triggered: access was removed on time. The sign-on report shows no activity after removal in any case.

reports.source: Workday, run on screen during the walkthrough
reports.procedure: Parameters inspected: system account jreyes; 10/01/2026 12:00 AM to 10/14/2026 11:59 PM; failed sign-ons included.

matters.text: The record that disabled the Workday account at 11:59 PM on 09/30/2026 does not name who or what made the change. Confirm that the account is disabled by the termination's effective date in Workday itself.
Attribute D is not concluded: access was removed on time, so the check of later activity was not triggered.
One instance was walked through. Operating effectiveness is tested separately on a sample of the period's leavers.

conclusion.text:
The control is designed to remove a leaver's access within 1 business day of the termination date, and the instance walked through shows it in place: the Workday account was disabled on the effective date, single sign-on was deactivated five minutes after midnight, and the remaining security group was removed the next morning, within the limit.

This is a conclusion on design and implementation only, proposed for the preparer and an independent reviewer to sign.
